name: singlet_evaluation_expression_based_cluster_purity
title: Label-free cluster purity scores
description: Computes label-free purity or heterogeneity scores for each cluster of one or more candidate partitions, using ROGUE (default), SCCAF held-out reliability or phiclust clusterability. Needs raw counts in layers/counts and cluster labels in obs; writes per-cluster scores and a granularity summary, and flags mixed clusters only after calibrated thresholds are set. Do not use it alone to choose a resolution, because finer partitions score as purer; do not use it on an embedding without counts.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle.

method.description: Score to compute; rogue is the default, sccaf and phiclust are comparators.

partition_keys.description: obs columns holding candidate partitions, one per resolution; each is scored per cluster.

gene_subset.description: uns key of the scoring gene list; fix it before any thinning or subsampling.

platform.description: Selects K = 45 for UMI or K = 500 for full-length data.

span.description: loess smoothing parameter of the expected entropy curve.

min_cell_n.description: Minimum cells per cluster and sample before a value is reported.

remove_outlier_n.description: Highest values removed per significant gene before refitting.

sample_key.description: obs column giving samples; null treats each cluster as one sample.

flag_below.description: Scores below this are flagged mixed; null until calibrated on B2.

classifier.description: Classifier for the self-projection; LR is the default.

sparsity.description: Inverse regularisation strength C of the logistic classifier.

fraction.description: Held-out test fraction of the stratified split.

cv.description: Cross-validation folds on the training split.

flag_below.description: Reliability below this is flagged mixed; null until calibrated on B2.

exp_genes.description: Fraction of genes setting the neighbourhood size, minimum 10.

p_val.description: Marchenko-Pastur fit p-value threshold for significant singular vectors.

nu.description: Number of singular values retained in the Marchenko-Pastur fit.

exclude_covariates.description: obs columns regressed out of singular vectors; recommended when technical axes are present.

flag_above.description: Clusterability above this is flagged mixed; null until calibrated on B2.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the held-out split, classifier and sampled Marchenko-Pastur fits.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/purity_rogue/cluster_table. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_clusters, n_flagged, n_genes, granularity (cell-weighted mean score per partition key).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
